overview.content:
SyncSpace is a Reddit-like website built using the MERN stack.
It allows users to create and join communities, known as subspaces, where they can post content, comment, and interact with others. The project was inspired by the Full Stack MERN Application series by JavaScript Mastery on YouTube.

list.caption: June 13, 2024 - June 22, 2024
list.title: Initial Setup
list.body: Since this was my first major project using the MERN stack and React.js, I followed a YouTube series to set up the project, structure the folders, and apply best practices.

list.caption: June 26, 2024 - July 24, 2024
list.title: Development
list.body: I developed the website's core functionalities, including user authentication, subspaces, posts, and comments. I built the backend endpoints first and then integrated them with the frontend, following a trial-and-error approach to refine the implementation. After completing this phase, I shared a post about it on LinkedIn.

list.caption: July 27, 2024 - August 5, 2024
list.title: Bug Fixes
list.body: I enhanced authentication security by implementing more robust validation methods and strengthening user data protection. This included implementing JWT-based authentication, secure session handling, and password hashing improvements.

list.caption: August 10, 2024 - August 18, 2024
list.title: Final Touches & Optimization
list.body: I integrated Cloudinary for media storage to ensure fast retrieval and better performance. Additionally, I optimized database queries to enhance the platform's speed and stability, reducing unnecessary calls and improving data fetching efficiency.

list.caption: Future Plans
list.title: Refactoring & Major Enhancements
list.body: I plan to revamp SyncSpace by introducing new features and further optimizing the architecture. This includes improved scalability, a better UI/UX, real-time functionalities, and more efficient database management.

features.label: Features

Infinite scrolling with scroll recovery
Audio player integration
Modern UI with Material-UI components

overview.content: CodeSync is a real-time collaborative coding platform designed for educational use. It enables developers to work together seamlessly with live code editing, a collaborative whiteboard, and audio communication. The platform is built for efficiency and scalability, using React, TypeScript, Node.js (Express), and Socket.IO. It features role-based permissions, authentication via Firebase, and plans for complex file structures and live site sharing. This project serves as my major academic work for my 8th semester.

list.caption: Aug 9, 2024 - Aug 16, 2024
list.title: Initial Setup & Planning
list.body: Researched various online code editors and real-time synchronization techniques. Ultimately, I chose CodeMirror, which has a built-in operational transformation feature for real-time code updates. On the backend, I used Socket.IO for other synchronization features like chat.

displayWithLabel.Note: The backend implementation of Socket.IO for real-time updates was primarily handled by Raj Kumar.

list.caption: Aug 21, 2024 - Sep 3, 2024
list.title: Development
list.body: Finalized a UI design by Yashika, which was implemented by Ayush Kumar and me. On the backend, we completed real-time chat, code execution, and the real-time whiteboard.

list.caption: Sep 16, 2024 - Oct 14, 2024
list.title: Feature Additions
list.subtitle: Enhancing Collaboration
list.body: Improved the UI for mobile devices and added features such as hand raise functionality, synchronous caret movement, and a participant info side panel.

features.label: Features
list: A shared code editor (using CodeMirror) allowing users to write, edit, and view code collectively.
Implemented Socket.IO for code synchronization and chat functionalities.
Multiple programming languages supported (Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, etc).
Console for immediate code execution (using code-compiler API).
Collaborative whiteboard (using Tldraw) for brainstorming and visual explanations.
Integrated chat for easy in-app communication.

overview.content: Sevakrit is a platform designed to address resource wastage by enabling individuals and communities to donate surplus goods such as food, clothes, books, and toys to NGOs. The platform bridges the gap between donors and NGOs, ensuring a secure and efficient donation process. This project was showcased at the ADGITM T-Hacks 6.0 hackathon, where our team, 'DevSquad,' secured a place among the top 15 teams in this highly competitive event, hosted by IEEE ADGITM.

list.caption: Sept 30, 2023
list.title: Initial Prototype
list.body: The prototype was created to evaluate feasibility and gain hands-on experience with Leaflet.js and the OpenStreetMap API. This phase helped define the project's core functionalities.

list.caption: Oct 1, 2023 - Oct 12, 2023
list.title: Development of v1
list.body: Version 1 was a basic client-side implementation featuring an interactive map. It served as the foundation for future iterations.

list.caption: Oct 12, 2023 - Oct 14, 2023
list.title: Bug Fixes & Minor Improvements
list.body: During this phase, initial bugs were identified and fixed, improving stability and user experience. Minor UI enhancements were also made.

list.caption: Oct 15, 2023 - Nov 22, 2023
list.title: Development of v2
list.body: Version 2 introduced an NGO portal, allowing NGOs to register, view donations, and manage requests more efficiently. The UI was refined, and backend optimizations were implemented.

list.caption: Nov 26, 2023 - Apr 19, 2024
list.title: Development of v3
list.body: Version 3 brought advanced features such as email notifications for new donations, different donation privacy settings (public, protected, and private), and automated cron jobs for periodic system tasks.

list.caption: Apr 24, 2023 - Aug 18, 2024
list.title: Bug Fixes & Refactoring
list.body: Over time, the codebase was occasionally updated to follow best practices and improve the folder structure. Several minor bugs were fixed along the way to enhance system performance and maintainability.

features.label: Features
list: Interactive map for tracking donations and NGO locations
Multi-user role-based access control for clients, NGOs, and admins
Admin dashboard for NGO verification and user management
Real-time NGO notifications based on donor proximity via email alerts
Customizable donation visibility (Private, Protected, Public) for client privacy and security
Reverse geolocation for automatic pickup address selection
User feedback system for platform improvement
